guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice has by far the largest anomalies (latency-90 +16752%, z=+358; socket +122%; mem +97%), and checkoutservice, its only caller, logs 33 warnings of 'failed to send order confirmation ... no healthy upstream'. Memory doubling (4.4e7 to 8.7e7) alongside rising sockets points to a memory fault, but socket exhaustion or delay can't be fully excluded since the digest doesn't show which one came first.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or reschedule the emailservice pod(s) to restore healthy upstreams, then inspect for a memory leak and raise memory limits if confirmed.
